title: knowgov register nodes report
description: What `python harness/register_nodes.py` prints and the MCP tool register_nodes returns (task-0142, doc-0020 C1): the register's nodes, sorted by id, under the filters named (taxonomy, kind, state, owner: a unit owning by the owner field or an approved owns link, parent: null for the nodes with no parent), with the total before the limit; or, with a node, that node and its lineage, every ancestor by parent nearest first to the root and the children with their states. Lineage is an annotation, never a reached node: no relationship is walked. Read from the register's files; no store. Version 1; a change is additive or a new version. Exit 2 prints no report.

missing.description: a parent the register names and does not hold; the climb ends there

owning_unit.description: with node only: the unit, its name and the approved owns links, as register_impact names them

total.description: the nodes under the filters, before limit and offset

truncated.description: true when nodes past this page match

ancestors.description: by parent, nearest first, the root last

root.description: the last ancestor, or the node itself when it has no parent

children.description: the nodes whose parent is this one, by id; listed, never walked

cycle.description: a parent met twice, which ends the climb; null on a register its checker accepts
